sn22.89:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghositārāme.
sn22.89:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā khemako badarikārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
sn22.89:1.3: atha kho therā bhikkhū sāyanhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhitā āyasmantaṃ dāsakaṃ āmantesuṃ:
sn22.89:1.4: “ehi tvaṃ āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi:
sn22.89:1.6: “kaccite āvuso khamanīyaṃ? kacci yāpanīyaṃ? kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti? paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti?
sn22.89:1.7: “evamāvusoti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.89:1.9: kacci te āvuso khamanīyaṃ? kacci yāpanīyaṃ? kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti? paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamoti?
sn22.89:1.10: na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamoti.
sn22.89:2.1: atha kho āyasmā dāsako yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etadavoca:
sn22.89:2.3: “na me āvuso khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati, no paṭikkamoti.
sn22.89:2.4: ehi tvaṃ āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama. upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi
sn22.89:2.8: imesu āyasmā khemako pañcasupādānakkhandhesu kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassatīti?
sn22.89:3.1: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmā khemakaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.89:3.5: imesu āyasmā khemako pañcasupādānakkhandhesu kiñci attanāṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassatīti.
sn22.89:3.6: pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā bhagavatā seyyathidaṃ:
sn22.89:3.8: imesu khohaṃ āvuso pañcasupādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmīti.
sn22.89:4.1: atha kho āyasmā dāsako yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā there bhikkhū etadavoca:
sn22.89:4.5: imesu khohaṃ āvuso pañcasupādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmīti.
sn22.89:4.6: ehi tvaṃ āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi:
sn22.89:4.10: no ce kirāyasmā khemako imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassati.
sn22.89:5.1: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.89:5.3: pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā bhagavatā seyyathidaṃ:
sn22.89:5.5: no ce kirāyasmā khemako imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu. kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassati, tena’hāyasmā khemako arahaṃ khīṇāsavoti.
sn22.89:5.6: pañcime āvuso upādānakkhandhā vuttā bhagavatā, seyyathidaṃ:
sn22.89:5.8: imesu khohaṃ āvuso, pañcasupādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmi, nacamhi arahaṃ khīṇāsavo,
sn22.89:5.9: api ca me āvuso pañcasupādānakkhandhesu ‘asmī’ti adhigataṃ, “ayamahamasmī”ti ca na samanupassāmīti.
sn22.89:6.1: atha kho āyasmā dāsako yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā
sn22.89:6.6: imesu kho’haṃ āvuso pañcasupādānakkhandhesu na kiñci attānaṃ vā attaniyaṃ vā samanupassāmi. na camhi arahaṃ khīṇāsavo,
sn22.89:6.7: apica me āvuso pañcasupādānakkhandhesu asmī’ti ‘adhigataṃ, ayamahamasmīti ca na samanupassāmī’ti.
sn22.89:7.1: ehi tvaṃ āvuso dāsaka, yena khemako bhikkhu tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā khemakaṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadehi:
sn22.89:7.9: yametaṃ āvuso khemaka, ‘asmī’ti vadesi, kimetaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadesī’ti?
sn22.89:8.1: evamāvusoti kho āyasmā dāsako therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ paṭissutvā yenāyasmā khemako tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.89:8.9: yametaṃ āvuso khemaka, ‘asmī’ti vadesi, kimetaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadesīti?
sn22.89:8.10: alaṃ āvuso dāsaka, kiṃ imāya sandhāvanikāya,
sn22.89:9.1: atha kho āyasmā khemako daṇḍamolubbha yena therā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā therehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ sammodi.
sn22.89:9.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ therā bhikkhū etadavocuṃ:
sn22.89:9.9: yametaṃ āvuso khemaka, “asmī”ti vadesi? kimetaṃ “asmī”ti vadesīti?
sn22.89:9.10: na kho’haṃ āvuso, rūpaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadāmi napi aññatra rūpā ‘asmī’ti vadāmi.
sn22.89:9.11: na vedanaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadāmi. napi aññatra vedanāya ‘asmī’ti vadāmi.
sn22.89:9.14: ‘asmī’ti vadāmi. napi aññatra saṅkhārehi ‘asmī’ti vadāmi. napi aññatra viññāṇā asmīti vadāmi.
sn22.89:9.15: api ca me āvuso, pañcasupādānakkhandhesu ‘asmī’ti adhigataṃ “ayamahamasmī”ti na ca samanupassāmi.
sn22.89:10.1: seyyathāpi āvuso, uppalassa vā padumassa vā puṇḍarīkassa vā gandho.
sn22.89:10.2: yo nu kho evaṃ vadeyya: “pattassa gandhoti vā vaṇṇassa gandhoti vā kiñjakkhassa gandhoti vā sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyā’ti?
sn22.89:10.5: pupphassa gandhoti kho āvuso, sammā byākaramāno byākareyyāti.
sn22.89:10.6: evameva khohaṃ āvuso, na rūpaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadāmi, napi aññatra rūpā ‘asmī’ti vadāmi.
sn22.89:10.10: na viññāṇaṃ ‘asmī’ti vadāmi. napi aññatra viññāṇā ‘asmī’ti vadāmi.
sn22.89:10.11: api ca me āvuso, pañcasupādānakkhandhesu ‘asmī’ti adhigataṃ ayamahamasmīti na ca samanupassāmi.
sn22.89:11.1: kiñcāpi āvuso, ariyasāvakassa pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti atha khvassa hotiyeva pañcasupādānakkhandhesu aṇusahagato ‘asmī’ti māno ‘asmī’ti chando ‘asmī’ti anusayo asamūhato.
sn22.89:11.2: so aparena samayena pañcasupādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati
sn22.89:11.3: “iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthagamo,
sn22.89:11.7: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthagamoti.
sn22.89:11.8: tassa imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato yopissa hoti pañcasupādānakkhandhesu aṇusahagato ‘asmī’ti māno ‘asmī’ti chando ‘asmī’ti anusayo asamūhato, sopi samugghātaṃ gacchati.
sn22.89:12.1: seyyathāpi āvuso, vatthaṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ malaggahitaṃ. tamenaṃ sāmikā rajakassa anuppadajjuṃ.
sn22.89:12.2: tamenaṃ rajako ūse vā khāre vā gomaye vā sammadditvā acche udake vikkhāleti.
sn22.89:12.3: kiñcā’pi taṃ hoti vatthaṃ parisuddhaṃ pariyodātaṃ, atha khvassa hoteva aṇusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato.
sn22.89:12.4: tamenaṃ rajako sāmikānaṃ deti. tamenaṃ sāmikā gandhaparibhāvite karaṇḍake nikkhipanti.
sn22.89:12.5: yo’pissa hoti aṇusahagato ūsagandho vā khāragandho vā gomayagandho vā asamūhato, so’pi samugghātaṃ gacchati.
sn22.89:12.6: evameva kho āvuso, kiñcāpi ariyasāvakassa pañcorambhāgiyāni saññojanāni pahīnāni bhavanti, atha khvassa hotiyeva pañcasupādānakkhandhesu aṇusahagato ‘asmī’ti, māno ‘asmī’ti, chando ‘asmī’ti anusayo asamūhato.
sn22.89:12.7: so aparena samayena pañcasupādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassī viharati.
sn22.89:12.8: “iti rūpaṃ, iti rūpassa samudayo, iti rūpassa atthagamo,
sn22.89:12.12: iti viññāṇaṃ, iti viññāṇassa samudayo, iti viññāṇassa atthagamoti.
sn22.89:12.13: tassa imesu pañcasupādānakkhandhesu udayabbayānupassino viharato yo’pissa hoti pañcasupādānakkhandhesu aṇusahagato ‘asmī’ti, māno ‘asmī’ti, chando ‘asmī’ti anusayo asamūhato, sopi samugghātaṃ gacchatīti.
sn22.89:13.1: evaṃ vutte therā bhikkhū āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn22.89:13.2: “na kho mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ khemakaṃ vihesāpekhā āpucchimhā api cāyasmā khemako pahoti tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena ācikkhituṃ desetuṃ paññapetuṃ paṭṭhapetuṃ vivarituṃ vibhajituṃ uttānīkātuṃ.
sn22.89:13.3: tayidaṃ āyasmatā khemakena tassa bhagavato sāsanaṃ vitthārena acikkhitaṃ desitaṃ paññapitaṃ paṭṭhapitaṃ vivaritaṃ vibhajitaṃ uttānīkatanti.
sn22.89:14.2: attamanā therā bhikkhū āyasmato khemakassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanduṃ.
sn22.89:14.3: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsu āyasmato ca khemakassāti.
